# telnyx_porting_order_share (Action)

Creates a link to share a porting order. The link is sent by the API, not returned to Terraform.



<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The object's id.

### Optional

- `expires_in_seconds` (Number) The number of seconds the token will be valid for
- `permissions` (String) The permissions the token will have One of `porting_order.document.read`, `porting_order.document.update`.
